display.purpose: The countdown inside the dial's sun (38px at the dial's 360 scale; 26px for words longer than three characters).

headline.purpose: Person-page countdown, today's name (1.6rem), the add flow's name field.

title.purpose: Lens label, calendar month heading (up to 1.5rem), list headings; section titles at 1rem.

countdown.purpose: The tabular numeral leading each birthday row and month-list date.

body.purpose: Names in rows (500), form text at 1rem so iOS never zooms.

label.purpose: Tab labels, weekday initials, the unit under a countdown (600 to 700).

shadows.name: sun-lift
shadows.purpose: Only under the raised Add button, paired with a 4px page-colored ring.

shadows.name: choice-lift
shadows.purpose: Month choices sitting on the add flow's ring.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Focus ring on controls, fields and the dial.

motion.name: ease-arrive
motion.purpose: Things arriving: sun rise, flame ignite, beads settling, choices appearing, the added bead landing.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: Strokes drawing: the mark's ring, the dial's year, the add flow's month arc.

motion.name: mark-intro
motion.value: about 2.1s: sun rises at 0s; spark draws 330 degrees from 0.25s over 1.4s; flame ignites at 1.55s; idle from 2.1s
motion.purpose: The logo's story, once per app open in the header, and on sign-in.

motion.name: dial-intro
motion.value: ring draws 1.35s from 0.15s; beads settle in date order from 250ms to 1350ms; busy arcs fade at 1.3s; lens fades at 1.35s; flame ignites at 1.45s
motion.purpose: The year dial's opening, once per app open.

motion.name: flame-flicker
motion.purpose: Idle flame on the mark and the dial.

motion.name: today-glow
motion.purpose: Behind the flame when someone's birthday is today.

motion.name: dial-snap
motion.value: exponential ease-out, 280ms plus 3ms per day turned, max 700ms
motion.purpose: The dial easing to a whole day after a drag or a jump.

motion.name: add-stagger
motion.value: choices 0.38s, 25ms per month and 12ms per day; arc draw 0.5s; bead land 0.6s; confirmation 0.45s
motion.purpose: The add flow placing someone on the ring.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all keyframes gated on prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference
motion.purpose: Everything rests still under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
Orbit is the logo grown to the size of an app. A royal-blue ring with round caps, open at today, with the logo's marigold flame burning in the gap; a marigold sun at the center; cream paper underneath (deep navy at night). Everyone the owner cares about is a bead on that ring at their birthday's angle, so the year is one shape rather than a list. The same ring, at the same geometry, appears on the home dial and in the add flow, and the month grid on the calendar reuses its beads. The orbit is the product's own language, never decoration laid over a generic agenda.

The feel is warm, round and quiet. Faces are rounded (Nunito at extrabold for numbers, names and headings), surfaces are soft-cornered and flat, and the only bright color is the sun. Density is phone-first and calm: one column, big tap targets, few lines per person, and summaries (counted beads, thickened busy weeks, "Show N more") instead of long lists. Motion tells the name's story: the mark's intro draws the ring with a travelling spark that lights the flame, the dial draws the year from today while beads settle in date order, and at rest the flame flickers and the sun breathes. Every animation rests still under reduced motion.

Light and dark follow the phone; there is no theme switch. The browser's own surfaces (selection, caret, scrollbar, theme color) carry the palette, and the app suppresses web-page tells (tap highlight, text selection outside fields, link callouts, image drag) so it behaves like an installed app.
keyCharacteristics: The year is a ring: 360-unit box, radius 124, 13-unit round-capped royal stroke, an 18° gap at today holding the flame.
Marigold means now: today, the lens in focus, the selected choice, and the one standing invitation (Add).
Royal blue is structure and "this week": the ring, interactive text, done states, near countdowns.
Rounded Nunito extrabold for anything you glance at; Geist for anything you read.
Flat tonal surfaces with generous radii (14px to 22px); depth from paper, card and soft tints, not shadow.
Motion follows the logo's intro once per app open, then settles to a slow flicker and breath.

rules.name: The Sun Means Now Rule
rules.body: Marigold marks what is happening now or what is in focus: today, the lens, the current choice, and the Add invitation. Upcoming-but-not-today is blue; everything else is ink on paper. If marigold appears, something on that spot is today or selected.

rules.name: The Brown Ink Rule
rules.body: Anything set on marigold uses Sun Ink, and "done" on a marigold card inverts to Sun Ink ground with marigold text, so state reads in both themes.

rules.name: The Rounded Glance Rule
rules.body: Numbers, names in focus and headings are Nunito at 700 to 800; sentences and details are Geist. Nunito never sets a paragraph.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every countdown, date numeral and bead count uses tabular figures so they don't jitter while the dial turns.

rules.name: The Paper Not Plastic Rule
rules.body: Cards and tiles never cast shadows; separation is a tonal step or a hairline. A shadow is reserved for something that sits physically above the ring or the bar.

dos: Do draw any view of the year with the shared ring: 360 box, radius 124, 13-unit round-capped stroke, the gap and flame at today.
Do keep marigold for now and focus (today, the lens, the selection, Add) and set Sun Ink on it.
Do lead a person's row with how far away they are, in tabular Nunito extrabold.
Do summarise crowds: merged and counted beads, thickened busy weeks, "Show N more" past two pending.
Do separate surfaces with tonal steps and hairlines, with corners from 14px (controls) to 22px (cards) and full circles for anything on the orbit.
Do give every animation a still rest under reduced motion, and play intros once per app open, never on every navigation.
Do use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for things arriving and `cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1)` for strokes drawing.
donts: Don't close the ring or move the gap away from today; the open ring with the flame is the logo.
Don't set white text on marigold, or use marigold for upcoming-but-not-today.
Don't add drop shadows to cards, rows or tiles; only the Add button and the add flow's ring choices lift.
Don't set paragraphs in Nunito or headings in Geist.
Don't use uppercase beyond three-letter month and weekday abbreviations.
Don't add a theme switch; light and dark follow the phone.
